assumptions: all selector and constructor costs charged
larger portfolio is not assumed better
selector generalization is measured on disjoint regimes
falsifier: Robust selector/portfolio does not beat strongest fixed/selection parent on fully-costed fresh regimes, selector regret remains material, or correctness/fallback gates fail.
minimal_counterexamples: portfolio overfits development and loses fresh
exact field dominated by cheap proxy
single query makes any field build irrational
selector picks unsupported regime instead of fallback
novelty_residual: Robust cheapest-useful mechanic selection across regimes beyond any single field and beyond an overfit selector.
object_description: Robust per-instance/regime selection over no-field and multiple validated field constructors, with portfolio size and selector generalization treated as first-class costs/risks.
oracle_or_lower_bound: Exact per-instance total cost for every frozen constructor defines the oracle portfolio choice and selector regret; fresh-regime error bounds selector generalization.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped field/heuristic portfolio selection and search economics only.
qoi: Fresh-regime paired net search utility versus strongest fixed constructor and strongest robust selector parent, plus selector regret versus oracle best portfolio action.
same_system_ablation: Same workloads with no-field, strongest fixed field, Hydra-style portfolio, and robust selector under identical constructor portfolio.

strongest_parents.justification: best fixed cheap constructor chosen on development only
controls selector generalization/overfit rather than only in-sample oracle choice
upper bound/regret reference, not promotable treatment

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = portfolio_build/training + selector + selected_build + maintenance + queries*(extraction+search+verification)
